[EN] Rhodos said the archdevas were transforming people into demokrons. But he seems shocked to see it first-hand.

Still, we must keep our heads and pursue that archdeva!
[ES] Rhodos dijo que los archidevas estaban transformando a la gente en demokrons. Pero parece sorprendido de verlo de primera mano.

Aun así, ¡debemos mantener la cabeza fría y perseguir a ese archideva!
